notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (www.homecentre.in/robots.txt) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot disallow, only disallows cart/checkout/search/account/utility paths for User-agent:* - proceeded via tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only, no browser needed. Site is Next.js SSR; every /in/en/c/<slug> category page embeds a __NEXT_DATA__ JSON blob containing props.initialState.unbxdListingPageReducer.data.response.numberOfProducts (exact site-displayed count), .response.products (sample of actual listed products, used to verify primary product type), .searchMetaData.queryParams.p (the exact category filter applied - used to confirm the page actually resolved the requested slug and did not silently fall back), and props.initialState.metaDataReducer.data.h1 plus unbxdCategoryDataReducer.data.breadcrumbs (used to confirm h1/breadcrumb matches the requested node on every leaf, per Step 2.2). Fetched with curl + Node.js (no python3 on this machine; used node to parse the embedded JSON). TREE METHOD: union of (1) sitemapindex.xml -> per-department sitemap XML files (furnishing.xml, bathandlaundry.xml, kitchen.xml, livingroom.xml, bedroom.xml, homeoffice.xml, outdoor.xml, diningroom.xml, decor.xml, gifts.xml, appliances.xml, customizedfurniture.xml, toppages.xml) giving every /c/ category slug the site has ever published, (2) the homepage mega-menu nav (homeMainNavNodes in NEXT_DATA) confirming the 10 live top-level departments: Sale, Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Decor, Kitchen, Furnishings, Tableware (department code 'dining' - NOT present in sitemapindex.xml, discovered only via nav + cross-category facet leakage), Bath & Laundry, Gifting, and (3) each live parent category page's own categoryFacetValue_uFilter facet (a full cross-tab of every sub-category code+name+count reachable under that node) which was used both to confirm which sitemap slugs are still live and to surface additional live leaves absent from the sitemap entirely (e.g. furnishing-bedding-dohars, and the whole dining-tableaccessories Table Linen subtree). Every sitemap slug that was a genuine candidate was fetched directly; slugs returning HTTP 302 to the bare homepage (/in/en) with no NEXT_DATA payload were treated as dead/removed categories and excluded (furnishing-accessories-bottlecovers, furnishing-accessories-mats, furnishing-accessories-yogamats, furnishing-appliancecovers + its child appliancecoversandmats, furnishing-bedding-cottonbedsheets, furnishing-curtains-curtainrods [hardware, would have been excluded anyway], furnishing-curtains-floralcurtains, furnishing-floorcoverings-mats, furnishing-floorcoverings-rugs [confirmed dead by the fact that carpets+dhurries+doormats = 632 = the parent Floor Coverings total exactly, i.e. rugs contributes nothing separate], bathandlaundry-bath-mask, bathandlaundry-laundry-wicker, kitchen-kitchenlinens-gloves, kitchen-kitchenlinens-runnersandmats, kitchen-storageandcontainers-bags/breadbins/drawerorganisers/dustbins/saltandpeppershakers, livingroom-sofas-sofacovers [duplicate of the live furnishing-accessories-sofacovers], diningroom-diningchairs-diningchaircovers, livingroom-shoeracks-diyfabricshoeracks, livingroom-wallshelves + both its children, livingroom-benchandstools-storagebenches/storagestools). furnishing-bedding-fittedbedsheets returned HTTP 200 with a plausible count (283) but no page-specific h1 (generic 'Bedding | Furnishing' meta fallback) and is absent from the parent Bedding facet tree entirely while its product sample only 1/3-overlapped with the confirmed live singlebedsheets(283) listing - failed the h1/canonical confirmation check so excluded per Step 2.2 rather than risk a silently-wrong count. QTY METHOD: exact numberOfProducts field read directly from each individual leaf category page's own SSR JSON (never taken from a parent facet cross-tab, which was observed to under/mis-count relative to the leaf's own page - e.g. the furnishing-bedding parent facet showed Dohars=4 but the Dohars page itself showed 27, confirmed correct by its own matching h1 'Dohars'). EXCLUDED (scope boundary, not access failure): furnishing-accessories-bags (h1 'Tote Bags' - fashion/carry bag, not home textile or home storage per both rulesets' explicit Tote-Bag exclusion example); furnishing-accessories-padsandmats (h1-confirmed products are furniture corner-protectors/floor-protecting-pads/furniture-sliders, not textile or storage); furnishing-curtains-rodsandaccessories (hardware); kitchen-storageandcontainers-bottles/glassbottles/flask (drinkware, Kitchen&Dining); kitchen-storageandcontainers-trays (Kitchen&Dining/Decorative per storage.md Serving Tray example); kitchen-storageandcontainers-lunchboxandbags (food-carrying lunch boxes/bags, Kitchen&Dining not home storage/textile); bathandlaundry-laundry-dustbins (waste bins, not storage per project precedent); bathandlaundry-laundry-hangersandhooks (plain clothes hangers/wall hooks, hardware/accessory not a storage container/organizer product); bathandlaundry-laundry-cleaningaccessories/clothdryers/ironingboards (cleaning tools/appliances, explicitly excluded by storage.md SS11); dining-tableaccessories-trivetandcoasters (heat-protection accessory, not fabric, Kitchen&Dining/Decorative scope); dining-tableaccessories-napkinsandtissueholders and -tissueholders (rigid holders/dispensers, hardware not textile); all Furniture-boundary nodes (sofas, beds incl. storage-beds, wardrobes, chest-of-drawers, bookcases/cabinets, TV/media units, ottomans-with-storage, benches/stools, tables-with-storage, dining sideboards/hutch/serving-trolleys) per the explicit 'if site places it in a Furniture category, prefer Furniture' rule in storage.md SS21/SS27; all Lighting, Kitchen&Dining crockery/cutlery/serveware, and Decor/Wall-Accent nodes under the decor.xml and kitchen.xml sitemaps. A curated cross-department landing page at /in/en/c/organisers (131 products) was found and inspected via its facet breakdown but excluded in full as a Collection/marketing aggregate rather than a genuine distinct category - 93 of its 131 items are tagged Furniture (bookcases, TV units, beds, dressers, tables) and the small remainder (kitchen storage&containers, bathandlaundry laundry-storage, livingroom shoe-cabinets) simply re-surfaces items already captured under their own canonical category pages recorded below; it is not a top-level mega-menu item (confirmed against the 10-node homeMainNavNodes list) so counting it would double-count. Similarly /in/en/c/homeware-mats (76, bath-mat products under a legacy alternate taxonomy path, not reachable from any live mega-menu or sitemap) was treated as a duplicate alias of the canonical bathandlaundry-bath-bathmats(221) listing and dropped per the duplicate-navigation-path rule. No block/CAPTCHA/DataDome encountered at any point; all fetches returned normal 200/302 responses.
